# `kernel/ledger/ToolCallTrace.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/ledger/ToolCallTrace.js`

ToolCallTrace.js — wraps engine/state/workflow/Outbox.js + Reconciler.js: every AI-initiated tool call is recorded as a transactional effect INTENT (idempotent by stable effect id — commit retries never duplicate a call), delivered via drain(), with ambiguous outcomes parked as RECONCILE and resolved by EVIDENCE (a probe of the authoritative status), never guessed.

## Classes

### `class ToolCallTrace`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor()` |  |
| `record` | `record(requestId, { toolName, args = {}, idempotencyKey = null, requiresApproval = false, reversible = false, compensatable = false })` | Record an intended tool call for a request (does NOT execute it). |
| `drain` | `async drain(deliver, opts = {})` | Deliver pending tool calls through an executor. |
| `reconcile` | `async reconcile(probe)` | Resolve parked (ambiguous) calls by probing authoritative status. |
| `entries` | `entries(requestId)` | All outbox entries for one request (UI view). |
| `status` | `status(effectId)` |  |
| `settle` | `settle(effectId, { ok = false, ack = null, error = null, ambiguous = false } = {})` | Settle an intent that was delivered by the AI executor's idempotent path. |
| `pendingCount` | `pendingCount()` |  |
| `reconcileCount` | `reconcileCount()` |  |

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
